knowledge.name: Synthetic market universe
knowledge.detail: Eight fictional companies with region, revenue, EBITDA, growth, recurring revenue, criteria scores and risks.

knowledge.name: Acquisition thesis and weights
knowledge.detail: One fixed thesis with sector, region, revenue band, profitability filter and three named weightings.

knowledge.name: Evidence source register
knowledge.detail: Dated synthetic sources per target used for citations, staleness checks and research requests.

intelligence_processing.name: Thesis to screening criteria
intelligence_processing.detail: Use when someone describes an acquisition thesis and wants it turned into screening criteria and filters.

intelligence_processing.name: Ranked target longlist
intelligence_processing.detail: Use when someone wants the screen run and the passing companies ranked with a transparent weighted score.

intelligence_processing.name: Cited target dossier
intelligence_processing.detail: Use when someone wants one target's profile, synthetic financials, criteria scores, sources and diligence questions.

intelligence_processing.name: Weighting challenge
intelligence_processing.detail: Use when someone asks whether the ranking holds under different weightings, such as weighting financial quality more heavily.

intelligence_processing.name: Evidence-gap review
intelligence_processing.detail: Use when someone asks where the evidence behind the targets is thin, missing or out of date.

intelligence_processing.name: Investment committee memo draft
intelligence_processing.detail: Use when someone asks for the investment committee screening memo draft for the shortlist.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the six-skill Draft agent with two synthetic knowledge files; publishing is a separate gated step.

clients_user_interface.name: Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot access
clients_user_interface.detail: Conversational entry point for corporate development once approved production controls exist.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file MATargetSourcingAgent locally with deterministic routing.

management_reporting.name: Ranked longlist view
management_reporting.detail: Shows filters, exclusions, weighted scores and the shortlist with the leader called out.

management_reporting.name: Evidence coverage view
management_reporting.detail: Lists missing and stale evidence per target with draft research requests.

management_reporting.name: Committee memo draft
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes the shortlist, conditions and the ask, marked Draft and not sent.

tools.name: Portable MATargetSourcingAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with six deterministic, read-only operations over synthetic data.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server that discovers the agent and exposes chat and health endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the six-skill package in Draft; explicit approval is required before publication.

tools.name: Approved market-data source
tools.detail: Cited production seam for company financials; no live connection exists in the package.

tools.name: Deal CRM (read-only seam)
tools.detail: Cited production seam for pipeline context; the agent never writes to it.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses only bundled fictional companies and sources; never browses or enriches from live data.

supporting_features.name: Transparent scoring
supporting_features.detail: Every score is criteria times published weights, shown in the answer and testable under alternatives.

supporting_features.name: Citation-first answers
supporting_features.detail: Dossier figures and risks cite synthetic source IDs; stale and missing evidence is flagged.

supporting_features.name: No external side effects
supporting_features.detail: Never contacts targets, updates a CRM, shares documents or sends the memo.

supporting_features.name: Human investment authority
supporting_features.detail: Shortlist approval, outreach and investment decisions stay with the corporate development lead.
